findings.title: Secret rotation is documented but not scheduled or monitored
findings.note: Runbooks exist; no owner/date tracker or expiry alert.
findings.impact: Credentials can outlive their intended lifetime.
findings.recommendation: Add an inventory with owners + last-rotated dates and an alert on overdue rotation.

findings.title: `.env` example files diverge between environments
findings.note: dev vs prod example key sets differ; WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY absent from both.
findings.recommendation: Generate env examples from a single schema.
